title: TileSet animation property sections collapse after adding or editing frames
body: ### Tested versions Reproduced in Godot v4.7.1.stable.official. Tested in Godot v4.6.1.stable.official, where the issue does not occur. This appears to be a regression introduced between 4.6.1 and 4.7.1. ### System information Godot v4.7.1.stable - Windows 11 (build 26200) - Multi-window, 3 monitors - Direct3D 12 (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5070 Ti (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.9186) - AMD Ryzen 7 5800X 8-Core Processor (16 threads) - 31.88 Gio memory - WASAPI (48000 Hz, Stereo/mono) ### Issue description When editing an animated tile in the TileSet editor, the expanded property sections collapse after every change. For example, after expanding the `Animation` section and then the `Frames` section, adding a new frame causes both sections to collapse. The same thing happens when changing the duration of an animation frame. As a result, the user has to reopen `Animation`, then `Frames`, after every modification. This makes editing tile animations unnecessarily slow and frustrating. A short gif is attached to this issue to demonstrate the behavior. The issue is easily reproducible in the TileSet editor. I have not verified whether the same behavior also occurs in other parts of the Inspector. ### Steps to reproduce 1. Create a new project. 2. Create a new TileSet resource. 3. Create a tile and enable animation. 4. Expand the `Animation` section. 5. Expand the `Frames` section. 6. Add a new animation frame. 7. Observe that both sections collapse. 8. Expand them again and change the duration of any frame. 9. Observe that the sections collapse again. ### Minimal reproduction project (MRP) N/A
